errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.messaging_unavailable: We cannot send codes right now. Try again in a few minutes.

update.title: Update the app
update.body: This version of the app is no longer supported. Update it from your app store to keep working.
update.soft_body: A newer version of the app will be required soon. Update it from your app store.

sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.subtitle: Enter the mobile number your dispatcher registered. We will send you a code on WhatsApp.
sign_in.sent_generic: If this number is registered, a code was sent to it.

verify.title: Enter the code
verify.resend_in: You can request a new code in {seconds} seconds.
verify.otp_invalid: The code is incorrect or has expired. Check it and try again.
verify.device_limit: This number is already signed in on two phones. Ask your dispatcher to remove an old phone, then request a new code.
verify.device_revoked: This phone was removed by your dispatcher. Ask them before signing in again.

account.title: Choose the account
account.subtitle: Your number drives for more than one merchant. Choose the one you are working for now.

pin.setup_rule: Choose 4 to 6 digits. You will enter it each time you collect cash.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match. Start again.
pin.otp_body: To save your PIN, enter the new code we sent to your WhatsApp.
pin.arm_body: Enter your cash PIN once so this phone can check it when you are offline.
pin.invalid: The PIN is incorrect. Try again.
pin.locked_body: Your cash PIN is locked after too many wrong tries. Ask your dispatcher to reset it. You can still deliver orders without cash.

permissions.title: Allow access
permissions.intro: The app needs these to run your deliveries. You can decide later for each one.
permissions.location_body: Your dispatcher and the recipient see where the parcel is, only while you are on shift. Off shift, nothing is sent.
permissions.background_body: Keeps sharing your position when the screen is off during a shift, so the recipient sees you arrive.
permissions.background_warning: Without background location, your position is shared only while the app is open.
permissions.notifications_body: Tells you about new orders and changes to your run.
permissions.camera_body: Scans parcel labels and takes delivery photos.

native.location_when_in_use: Your dispatcher and the recipient see where the parcel is, only while you are on shift.
native.location_always: Keeps sharing your position during a shift when the screen is off, so the recipient sees you arrive. Off shift, nothing is sent.
native.camera: Scans parcel labels and takes delivery photos.
